svg.title: Gathering areas, Mining: a level 3 Tauren in Mulgore gets Red Cloud Mesa (its starting area's own, never the zone's level 9 area by the Venture Co. mine), shaded on the zone map with its veins dotted, the veins on the minimap, and inside it the arrow's roam line; then a level 7 Orc in Durotar, past the Valley of Trials, by Razor Hill
